nodes.label: Nomisma macOS native app
nodes.rationale: Bundles Python/backend and provides native menus, dialogs, printing and opt-in notifications. Workspace builds reuse the existing database and healthy matching service without automatically starting a market monitor.

nodes.label: macOS bundle build and portable mode
nodes.rationale: The builder copies source, verifies runtime relocation/libraries/imports/signature and targets the current architecture on macOS 13+. Bundles exclude credentials/research data. Portable mode removes workspace paths and uses Application Support; public distribution needs Developer ID signing/notarization.

nodes.label: Persistent macOS local-service lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Closing or quitting the native app leaves the server and schedules running. Reopening/reloading does not reload credentials. Startup searches loopback ports 8765–8795, preserves other applications and restricts native capabilities to the active workspace.
